description: A pack's or mix's options (outfit, place, light, shots, shape and the attribute pickers), with ids, labels and defaults, and its price per photo. A pack's top names the 3 pickers to offer first, under the pack's own names; a pack without a place or light has an empty list for it. Each shot is one photo, and the user may pick any of them, from one to all (the default). start_shoot takes these ids.
name: get_pack
title: Get a pack's options
